title: Broken Invariant - Invalid status enum, wrong types, missing many required fields
description: This fixture intentionally fails Omnia v1 invariant.schema.json validation in multiple ways: 1) status uses invalid enum (not proposed/implemented/validated_mock/validated_live_target/deprecated), 2) runtime_host_independent is string not boolean, 3) severity uses invalid enum value, 4) MANY required properties are missing entirely: scope, applicability, preconditions, required_observations, required_capabilities, decision_rule, outcomes, remediation_refs, source_refs, authority_ceiling, forbidden_actions, dependency_ids, last_verified.
